Freshsales CRM integration skill — initial release.

- Manage contacts, leads, deals, accounts, tasks, and sales sequences using the Freshsales API.
- Includes tracking of deal pipelines, automated lead assignments, activity logging, and sales reporting.
- Designed for Python 3.10+; no external dependencies (stdlib only).
- CLI commands for all major Freshsales CRM operations with JSON or human-readable output.
- No data stored locally; all requests made directly to Freshsales.
